title: Scan from either phone and explicitly allow instant QR connection
summary: Add a main-screen scanner, one-use owner-authorized QR connection, camera flashlight/retry, and viewer recovery. Fix rapid taps incorrectly disconnecting an approved session.

changes.detail: Either idle phone can open Scan a phone directly and become the viewer. Owner taps Allow QR connection on the sharing phone to grant one scanner screen/control access without a second approval tap. Separate random QR capability expires after two minutes and is revoked when hidden, replaced, used or stopped.
Return non-authentication status codes for rapid taps, paused streaming and a locked screen, so the viewer does not revoke a valid session. Reject scanning the same phone.
Flashlight and camera retry; viewer reload retry with same-origin in-memory token restoration after WebView process loss, without persistent token storage.
Repair QR translations, update recovery guidance, and prepare version 1.0.14/build 16. Preserve manual owner approval and Android capture permission.

validation.name: Automated and native checks
validation.detail: New regression checks, TypeScript, lint and signed Android build pending.

validation.name: Physical acceptance
validation.detail: No connected devices. Either phone can scan the sharing phone; a reverse invitation QR displayed on an idle viewer is not implemented. Android capture/lock/process constraints remain. No deployment.
